title: Young Measure Based Quantum Linear Programming Algorithms for Nonlinear/Stochastic Multiscale Partial Differential Equations and Homogenization
summary: We study quantum algorithms for nonlinear and stochastic homogenization via a Young-measure based linear programming (LP) formulation, which lifts the nonlinear problem to a linear one in higher dimensions by treating the microscale, the gradient, and possible random variables as independent variables, thereby capturing effective macroscopic quantities without directly resolving fine-scale oscillations. The resulting LP is large but structured, and its high-dimensional nature creates regimes in which quantum LP solvers outperform direct classical solvers: in the deterministic setting,…
